prerequisites.label: GoHighLevel Private Integration Token (PIT)
prerequisites.satisfy: Add GOHIGHLEVEL_API_KEY=<your PIT> to this install's secrets env file (the file $SECRETS_ENV names) (chmod 600), then run tools/engine/wire-ghl-env.sh so the session environment carries it. Get the PIT from GHL Settings > Integrations > Private Integrations. GHL has no API keys; this is a PIT.

prerequisites.label: GoHighLevel Location ID
prerequisites.satisfy: Add GOHIGHLEVEL_LOCATION_ID=<your location id> to this install's secrets env file (the file $SECRETS_ENV names), then run tools/engine/wire-ghl-env.sh so the session environment carries it.

prerequisites.label: Convert and Flow Firebase refresh token (workflow writes only)
prerequisites.satisfy: Optional. Needed only for workflow build/edit. Grab it with the Token Grabber Chrome extension (Skill 44 INSTALL.md Action 5b), paste into this install's secrets env file as GOHIGHLEVEL_FIREBASE_REFRESH_TOKEN, then re-run wire-ghl-env.sh.

prerequisites.label: Skill 36 - GHL MCP Setup
prerequisites.satisfy: Skill 36 is the 6-tier GHL access chain; Skill 44 is Tier 0 inside it. In this pack the tier doctrine ships as vendored data and Skill 29 maps onto the pack rails by reference (see the pack ADAPTER.md); no separate Skill 36 install is required for the pack to run.

prerequisites.label: Python 3.9+
prerequisites.satisfy: Install Python 3.9 or newer. Mac: brew install python@3.12. Container installs: ships in the image.
